tasks.label: docker-up-wait-sql
tasks.command: bash -lc 'docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180 && for i in {1..60}; do docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T sqlserver /bin/bash -lc "(/opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P \"\$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD\" -Q \"SELECT 1\" -C -b -o /dev/null) || (/opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P \"\$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD\" -Q \"SELECT 1\" -b -o /dev/null)" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "SQL Server still not accepting connections after wait"; exit 1'
